claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lofexidine is a centrally acting alpha-2 adrenergic agonist with no known cytotoxic mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak killing likely reflecting nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a shared targeted mechanism.
